businessPolicy: Copy exact Host v1 business inputs. Run original full Native runReplyAgent and original SDK managed host. Retain every actual public/raw field and original error.

environment.gitPolicy: No .git entry of any type in any actual workspace or cwd ancestor through filesystem root, before dispatch and after actual exit. No configured repoRoot.
environment.projectFeaturePolicy: Original feature remains enabled. Repository absence is an explicit physical environment input; no project flag, helper result or manager operation is replaced.
environment.sdkStartup: A source-sealed pre-exec observer records actual cwd/environment and execs the original host_turn_barrier_sdk_cli in the same PID/stdin/environment. Initial startup argv and executed original-host argv are both retained honestly.
environment.pathMapping: Actual executionRoot/cwd/state/workspace and separate captureRoot are recorded without rewriting original strings or outputs.

frontier.outcomes: Every actual branch, warning, corpora field, hit, score and reply remains evidence. No expected result is supplied.
frontier.futureControls: Any optional publication frontier requires another explicit frozen control version before execution. No absent original owner may be fabricated.

custody.before: Source-qualified child records actual OS cwd, PID/PPID, explicit environment and canonical path/ancestor facts before original host dispatch. SDK exec preserves these OS facts and the original stdin.
custody.after: Coordinator checks all execution/capture paths and .git ancestry again after the observed OS exit; Native entry also retains a post-host environment observation.
custody.sources: Seal input/contract, all adapter/entry/preload/source bytes, approved original reference/runtime and Node/Python identities before engines; reject any changed source or foreign capture.
custody.businessReplay: Unchanged Host v1 business custody validators validate actual original Native/SDK observations. V2 environment admission is additional and cannot weaken those checks.
custody.retention: Retain original stdout/stderr/raw packets, traces and actual state DB/WAL/SHM bytes separately. No execution-root cleanup until actual exit and verified lossless archive/restore proof.

scope.promotion: Requires explicit root review after actual proof and exact Host/FIF version migration; do not claim old1452 prefix unchanged after later replacement.
